queue.title: Recently got a new job, boss already calling me/texting me to come in through my off days, is this a red flag?
queue.body: I recently got a new job and my boss is already calling me during the days I'm not scheduled, texting me to cover a shift less than an hour from when he called and texted. I feel like he's trying to test the waters to see how much I'll go through with it, but I'll just say I don't pick up the phone since I'm doing something busy during my off days (like working on my school). I already don't like where this is going.
queue.author: eggshellwalker4

queue.title: Boss runs my writing on ChatGPT to edit my work.
queue.body: I sent my boss a draft email for him to check before we send it out. He comes back to me with a concise version of the email that’s obviously been run through ChatGPT, hyphenation abound and impersonal tone (especially when we’re sending it as an ask to a bunch of people). It’s so insulting. I think my boss delegates his thinking to AI, I’ve absolutely lost respect for him.
queue.author: DanarysStormborn
